preceding_candidate_round.scope: Pre-backpressure correction, unchanged packet/KCP/mux code; retained for variation comparison, not final executable qualification.

development_findings.result: Exited 127 before measurement; not a throughput result. Compatible library used in all final runs.

development_findings.issue: Untuned separate ports with one backend receive worker regressed bulk
development_findings.result: Profiled receiver capture loss and dense fast-ACK clock overhead; enabled two capture workers and optimized one clock sample per ACK event. Final paired comparisons include both changes.

development_findings.issue: Old one-conversation-loss fixture expected no source recovery
development_findings.result: Updated assertion for per-carrier recovery: healthy siblings must survive; only blocked slot may change. Final exact-binary fixture passed.

development_findings.issue: Failed openings could qualify a live zero-window receiver for recovery
development_findings.result: Reproduced in a deterministic test, then suppressed recovery and suspicion while the live receive window is zero; failure evidence resumes after reopening. Full exact-binary namespace matrix repeated after correction.

development_findings.issue: Failures before first health sample could be forgotten
development_findings.result: Clock initialized on source reservation; deterministic repeated regression passed.

limitations: No production host accessed or redeployed in this qualification.
Clean bulk: three alternating pairs; WAN comparisons: one seeded pair each, not statistical guarantees.
Some capture drops at uncapped CPU ceiling; not zero-loss peak operation.
100k forwards mostly idle with laptop swap; does not qualify 100k busy users.
HTTP percentiles are histogram upper bounds; in-flight workload deadline cancellations are separate from failures.
Fresh source tuple cannot fix whole IP reachability; established streams on replaced carrier reconnect.
Captured CPU excludes benchmark generators and host-wide kernel/background cost; capture/socket storage lies outside Go memory limit.
Backend compatibility qualified against ownership.2, not unmodified upstream paqet.
Existing production full-day watch remains separate and unfinished.
